requirements.title_zh: 构建世界级AI创新生态体系
requirements.title_en: Build a world-class AI innovation ecosystem
report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
requirements.evidence_zh: 本方案在统筹研究章节给出“策源—孵化—加速—集聚—赋能”创新链与六类全球案例转化机制，并以 land_use 的 AI 研发创新用地与三处重点区图层承载；生态图谱与产业-空间映射见 A0 与视觉页。
requirements.evidence_en: The Coordinated Research section defines a source-incubate-accelerate-cluster-enable innovation chain with six global case-study mechanisms, carried by the AI R&D land-use zone and three key-area layers; the ecosystem map and industry-space mapping appear on A0 and the visual index.

requirements.title_zh: 建设适配AI新质生产力的新型城市形态
requirements.title_en: Build a new urban form adapted to AI new-quality productive forces
report_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
requirements.evidence_zh: 总体设计章节提出职住商服复合与全生命周期空间供给；FAR、总建筑规模、建筑密度明确 unknown 并说明重算触发条件，用地/建筑/道路图层承载空间形态，A3/A0 与视觉页联动呈现。
requirements.evidence_en: The Overall Design section proposes work-housing-commerce-service mix and lifecycle space supply; FAR, total floor area, and density are honestly unknown with recalc triggers; land-use/building/road layers and A3/A0/visual pages carry the spatial form.

requirements.title_zh: 打造全球AI创新人才向往的高品质城区
requirements.title_en: Create a high-quality district that global AI talent aspires to
report_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
requirements.evidence_zh: 六类用户画像与十二张场景卡覆盖工作-生活-社交-学习；公共空间与蓝绿空间图层及比例指标支撑高品质城区论证，无障碍与适老化服务作为人工复核基线写入场景卡。
requirements.evidence_en: Six personas and twelve scenario cards cover work-life-social-learning; public-space and blue-green layers with ratio metrics support the high-quality district case, with accessibility and elder-friendly human-fallback baselines in each scenario card.

requirements.title_zh: 统筹研究范围
requirements.title_en: Coordinated Research Area
report_sections: 三层范围工作框架
统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
requirements.evidence_zh: 三层范围框架将统筹研究范围（43.6 平方公里）的任务落实为创新链与产业-空间映射；公告文字四至为任务依据，provisional polygon 仅供生成与展示。
requirements.evidence_en: The three-level scope framework assigns Coordinated Research Area (43.6 km²) tasks to the innovation chain and industry-space mapping; announcement text boundaries anchor tasks while provisional polygons serve generation and display only.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围
requirements.title_en: Overall Design Area
report_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
requirements.evidence_zh: 总体设计范围以 11.4 平方公里的控规深度城市设计组织用地、更新与风貌；四类用地分区完整铺满提交边界，A3/A0 与视觉页展示结构关系。
requirements.evidence_en: The Overall Design Area (11.4 km²) organizes land use, renewal, and character at regulatory-plan depth; four land-use zones tile the submitted boundary completely, shown across A3/A0 and the visual index.

requirements.title_zh: 重点区域范围
requirements.title_en: Key Detailed Design Area scope
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
requirements.evidence_zh: 三处重点区在 key_areas.geojson 中以 provisional 标注，分别给出定位、空间动作、AI 场景与实施依赖；面积与公告约值对照校核。
requirements.evidence_en: Three key areas are marked provisional in key_areas.geojson, each with positioning, spatial moves, AI scenarios, and implementation dependencies; areas are cross-checked against announced values.

requirements.title_zh: 统筹研究范围：AI创新生态体系
requirements.title_en: Coordinated Research: AI innovation ecosystem
report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
requirements.evidence_zh: 全球案例表（六例，含一手来源、适用条件、不可照搬点与转化动作）支撑生态体系论证；生态图谱与八类机制见正文与 A0 生态板。
requirements.evidence_en: A six-case global table (with primary sources, applicability, non-transferable points, and local conversion moves) supports the ecosystem argument; ecosystem map and eight mechanisms appear in the narrative and A0 ecosystem board.

requirements.title_zh: 统筹研究范围：适配人工智能的未来城市形态
requirements.title_en: Coordinated Research: future urban form for AI
report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
requirements.evidence_zh: “自适应、可进化的城市发展模式”落实为连续无界蓝绿系统与复合慢行环；绿地/公共空间比例由提交几何复算并标注 provisional 边界依赖。
requirements.evidence_en: An adaptive, evolvable urban mode is grounded in a continuous borderless blue-green system and a composite slow-mobility ring; green/public ratios are recomputed from submitted geometry with provisional-boundary caveats.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围：产业目标与功能布局
requirements.title_en: Overall Design: industry goals and functional layout
report_sections: 总体设计范围城市更新与控规深度城市设计
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
requirements.evidence_zh: 结合“1+X+1”产业体系提出 AI+ 垂直应用重点区域与功能比例；AI 研发与产业服务用地分区承载，建筑基底面积复算。
requirements.evidence_en: AI+ vertical-application focus areas and functional proportions build on the '1+X+1' industrial system; AI R&D and industry-service zones carry the layout with recomputed building footprint area.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围：城市更新总体框架
requirements.title_en: Overall Design: urban renewal framework
report_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
用地、建筑规模与拆改留方案
requirements.evidence_zh: 更新总体结构落实为六个更新项目与一期可讨论范围；拆改留方法按权属/现状底数缺口降级为待核清单，不编造具体地块结论。
requirements.evidence_en: The renewal framework is carried by six renewal projects and a phase-1 discussion scope; retain-renovate-demolish methods are downgraded to a pending-verification list given missing ownership and building inventories.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围：交通轨道市政配套设施
requirements.title_en: Overall Design: transit, rail, municipal facilities
report_sections: 交通、轨道、市政与公共服务设施
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
requirements.evidence_zh: 道路中心线仅作设计示意并标注非红线；轨道站点一体化、慢行断点缝合与市政新基建方向为概念建议，道路/市政指标 unknown 并给出重算条件。
requirements.evidence_en: Road centerlines are design suggestions only and are labeled as non-redline; station integration, slow-mobility stitching, and municipal new-infrastructure directions are conceptual, with road/municipal metrics honestly unknown.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围：京张遗址公园活力带
requirements.title_en: Overall Design: Jing-Zhang Heritage Park activity belt
report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
requirements.evidence_zh: 遗址公园活力带以绿道主轴与复合慢行环承载南北贯通、东西连通；南端/北端与上跨环路节点给出地标化建议，文保与蓝线控制线缺失时保持概念边界。
requirements.evidence_en: The Heritage Park activity belt carries north-south through and east-west connectivity via a greenway spine and composite slow ring; landmark proposals for the south/north ends and ring-road crossings stay conceptual pending heritage and blue-line controls.

requirements.title_zh: 总体设计范围：城市风貌
requirements.title_en: Overall Design: urban character
report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
requirements.evidence_zh: 京张铁路历史-中关村创新-AI 新文化融合叙事形成城市基调；建筑高度/强度/风貌/屋顶形态控制均为引导性建议，官方控制缺失时以 unknown 呈现。
requirements.evidence_en: A fused Jing-Zhang railway, Zhongguancun, and AI culture narrative defines the urban tone; height/intensity/character/roof controls remain advisory, honestly unknown without official controls.

requirements.title_zh: 重点区域详细设计必选项
requirements.title_en: Key-Area Detailed Design mandatory item
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
requirements.evidence_zh: 三处重点区逐项给出产业功能、建筑规模方法、拆改留分类、交通组织与公共空间连通，达到规划综合实施方案的概念深度。
requirements.evidence_en: Each of the three key areas provides industry functions, building-scale method, DRR classification, traffic organization, and public-space connectivity at integrated-planning-implementation conceptual depth.

requirements.title_zh: 众智园AI自主创新加速区
requirements.title_en: Zhongzhiyuan AI Independent Innovation Acceleration Area
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
requirements.evidence_zh: 花园型全栈自主创新街区：清河界面、产业展示、低碳创新交往、绿色空间 AI 测试与标准治理展示；对外交通与五环方向衔接为概念建议。
requirements.evidence_en: Garden-type full-stack autonomous innovation district: Qinghe interface, industry display, low-carbon exchange, green-space AI testing, and standards-governance display; external-transit links to the Fifth Ring remain conceptual.

requirements.title_zh: 北京AI原点社区
requirements.title_en: Beijing AI Origin Community
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
requirements.evidence_zh: 近校型成果转化与人才社区：校区-园区慢行缝合、成果发布、人才特区、开源体系；拆改留按权属/底数缺口列为待核方法，五道口与清华东路西口站点一体化方向化。
requirements.evidence_en: Campus-adjacent transformation and talent community: campus-park slow-mobility stitching, achievement release, talent zone, and open-source system; DRR stays a pending method pending ownership/building data, and station integration at Wudaokou and Qinghua East Road West Exit is directional.

requirements.title_zh: 大钟寺AI产业聚集区
requirements.title_en: Dazhongsi AI Industry Cluster
report_sections: 重点区域详细设计
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
requirements.evidence_zh: 城市型智能经济街区：智能体/智能终端/内容消费新业态、数据要素与数字资产流通机制建议、规划绿地复合利用、大钟寺站四象限步行连通与静态交通组织概念。
requirements.evidence_en: Urban smart-economy district: AI-agent/smart-terminal/content-consumption businesses, data-factor circulation mechanisms, composite green-space use, Dazhongsi Station four-quadrant pedestrian connectivity, and static-traffic organization concepts.

requirements.title_zh: 一带总体概念与功能统筹方案设计
requirements.title_en: Belt overall concept and functional coordination design
report_sections: 三层范围工作框架
统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
requirements.evidence_zh: 主名称“京张智脉”、英文名与三层命名体系、Logo/VI 方向、三大定位、五大功能、三区两翼协同回路与“一带三核、多点场景、蓝绿慢行复合环”总体结构在正文、总览图与 A0 概念板上可见。
requirements.evidence_en: The main name 'Jing-Zhang AI Vein', English name, three-tier naming system, Logo/VI direction, three positioning pillars, five functions, three-zones-two-wings coordination loop, and the 'one belt, three cores, multi-scenario, blue-green slow ring' structure are visible in the narrative, overview figure, and A0 concept board.

requirements.title_zh: AI全栈自主创新体系与世界级AI创新生态设计
requirements.title_en: Full-stack independent AI innovation system and world-class ecosystem design
report_sections: 统筹研究范围产业与未来城市研究
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
visual_sections: 生态图谱与产业—空间映射
requirements.evidence_zh: proposal.md 的“AI 创新生态图谱与产业—空间映射”表把研发、孵化、测试、转化、规模化、传播六阶段逐项映射到三核两翼、公共节点、八类机制、运营角色与可核查输出；site-overview 图件、A0-1/A0-4、A3-3 和 visual/index.html 提供可见双语图谱。六个案例均指向具体官方页面并记录采集方法、时空覆盖、许可/限制、交叉核验和转化边界。
requirements.evidence_en: The proposal's AI ecosystem and industry-space table maps the six stages of research, incubation, testing, translation, scaling, and communication to the three cores/two wings, public nodes, eight mechanisms, accountable roles, and auditable outputs. The site-overview figure, A0-1/A0-4, A3-3, and visual/index.html show the bilingual map. All six cases point to specific official pages and record collection method, spatial/temporal coverage, rights/limits, cross-check, and transfer boundary.

requirements.title_zh: AI+场景赋能新范式与智能化AI活力城市设计
requirements.title_en: AI+ scenario enablement paradigm and smart AI vibrant city design
report_sections: AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
visual_sections: 蓝绿公共空间与交通慢行
requirements.evidence_zh: 十二张场景卡与六类 persona 保持完整；proposal.md 的“三个 TVS 的可测试服务蓝图”对 SC-02/08/11 分别给出 persona、触发入口、空间节点、前台/后台、输入/输出、合法来源、最小采集、人工复核、失败关闭、投诉申诉、责任、准入门槛、测试步骤、退出条件和 4 项指标获取方式，并明确人工窗口/电话/纸质表单提供等价服务。A0-3、A3-5、metrics-evidence 图件与视觉页可见。
requirements.evidence_en: The twelve scenario cards and six personas remain complete. The proposal's three testable TVS blueprints give SC-02/08/11 a persona, trigger, node, frontstage/backstage, input/output, lawful source, minimum collection, human review, fail-closed, complaint/appeal, responsibility, access gate, test steps, exit, and four measurable data methods, with equivalent counter/phone/paper service. They are visible in A0-3, A3-5, the metrics-evidence figure, and the visual index.

requirements.title_zh: AI公共空间、智能原生新业态与朝圣地标设计
requirements.title_en: AI public space, AI-native new businesses, and pilgrimage landmarks
report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
重点区域详细设计
requirements.evidence_zh: 京张遗址公园 AI 公共空间策略、东西缝合/南北贯通概念、大钟寺智能原生消费与商务场景、三个朝圣地标、荣誉展示体系与公共空间组件库；工程与文保结论保持概念建议边界。
requirements.evidence_en: Heritage Park AI public-space strategy, east-west stitch / north-south through concepts, Dazhongsi AI-native consumption and business scenarios, three pilgrimage landmarks, an honor display system, and a public-space component library; engineering and heritage conclusions stay conceptual.

requirements.title_zh: 百年京张文化、中关村文化与AI新文化融合叙事设计
requirements.title_en: Centennial Jing-Zhang culture, Zhongguancun culture, and AI new-culture narrative
report_sections: 蓝绿空间、公共空间与城市风貌
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
requirements.evidence_zh: 京张铁路历史（詹天佑 1909 年建成、清华园车站等）—中关村创新文化—AI 新文化三层叙事链、导视/标识/符号系统方向、空间载体与中英国际传播文案在正文与视觉页成文，历史事实保持保守表述并引用公开资料。
requirements.evidence_en: A three-layer narrative chain (Jing-Zhang railway history, Zhongguancun innovation culture, AI new culture), wayfinding/signage/symbol system direction, spatial carriers, and bilingual international communication copy are written in the narrative and visual index, with historical facts stated conservatively from public sources.

requirements.title_zh: 一带全球AI创新活动体系与长期运营设计
requirements.title_en: Belt global AI innovation event system and long-term operation design
report_sections: 更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划
AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景
requirements.evidence_zh: 年度活动日历与节奏、活动品牌/IP、开发者社区运营、场景开放运营、公共体验路线、国际传播与人才/企业/开发者转化路径完整成文；明确角色、门槛、复盘指标与“仍属提议”边界，不写成政府承诺。
requirements.evidence_en: An annual event calendar and rhythm, event brand/IP, developer-community operations, scenario-access operations, public experience routes, international communication, and talent/enterprise/developer conversion pathways are fully written with roles, thresholds, review metrics, and explicit 'still proposed' boundaries — not government commitments.
